[non-codebase] Historical replay evidence for the replay-proof AC, captured before Gerrit push from /Users/joeoakhart/bug-seahorse-duplicate-metrics using the merged implementation at 84e94070c819934e053f8883b4719cd215b14d7d:

- Duplicate replay window 2026-08-31T06:00:00Z..2026-09-01T04:00:00Z over durable local CREATE/FILE_IMPACT events: duplicate_title_peak_hour.peak_hour == 85, alarm == true; day-bucket context 233+172=405, with 425 as store-wide all-time excess.
- Creation-volume replay window 2026-09-04T21:25:00Z..2026-09-05T03:00:00Z over durable local CREATE events: create_volume_peak_hour.peak_hour == 1010, alarm == true. RCA fixed UTC-hour buckets peaked at 968; bridge-side outbound_differ counts were deliberately not used.
- Baseline replay window 2026-08-20T00:00:00Z..2026-08-25T00:00:00Z: duplicate_title_peak_hour.peak_hour == 1 and create_volume_peak_hour.peak_hour == 34, both below strict thresholds.

These are historical-store replay artifacts, not stable unit-test fixtures, because they depend on the live ticket store history rather than repository test data.
